reviewItem.question: Does "Metrics namespace: Some Loki metrics started with the prefix `cortex_`. In this release they will be changed so they start with `loki_`. To keep them at…" mean a change to config-key:loki|path=metrics_namespace (value-changed)?

proposed.statement: Loki 3.0.0 changes metrics namespace prefix from `cortex_` to `loki_`; the `metrics_namespace` config key can be set to `cortex` to retain the old prefix, but this setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release.
